Multiple CSS selectors each exclude their matched elements

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><nav class="nav">Menu</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['.nav', 'footer']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
